step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts a 3D immersive web experience streaming platform built on AWS. 1. A user connects via web browser to an API Gateway. 2. API Gateway routes requests through a Routing Lambda to determine optimal regional resources and latency. 3. The request moves to a Virtual Connection Lambda which interacts via WebSockets with a Fargate cluster. 4. Fargate checks ElastiCache to find suitable running EC2 instances and launches game workloads on EC2. 5. EC2 instances register with ElastiCache and pull game binaries from S3. 6. A Streaming Agent microservice on the EC2 instance establishes a direct WebRTC stream back to the end-user's browser.
